title: Backup scope · albums
expect: Native searchable virtualized choices contain 500 albums; 3 albums · about 4,210 photos is independent of search.
Mac opens an adaptive square-cover card grid in Settings detail, with album names, item counts and included checkmarks. All Albums and search remain above.
iPhone retains its full-width album rows and existing cover sizing; Mac uses square cover cards. A missing cover keeps its neutral thumbnail slot.
Scroll the virtualized choices and toggle an album: cover identity stays stable, off-screen requests cancel, and search, summary and checkmarks remain.

actions.result: All albums stays off and the summary becomes zero.

actions.action: Turn All albums on, then choose one album.
actions.result: The first explicit choice restricts the scope to that album.
